company.name: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

positions.title: Global Technology Summer Analyst Intern
positions.description:
●	Performed data analysis on historical stock price data using linear interpolation for missing data, as well as various metrics like sharpe ratio, and correlation matrix to create a diversified well performing portfolio.

●	Developed a set time series prediction model to forecast daily ATM volume with a target performance of less than 10% MAPE (Mean Absolute Error Percentage)

●	These models started with more classic approaches like linear regression and ARIMA, however progressed further into models like SARIMA/SARIMAX to account for seasonality and add exogenous variables.

●	Introduced Tensorflow deep learning into our models to improve our MAPE from previous models of ~9% 

●	Utilized Random Forest for feature selection and ranking

positions.title: Financial Services Representative
positions.description:
●	Assessed applicants using credit applications, financial statements, and property value to underwrite our risk

●	Analyzed application packets to ensure all necessary documents are present to adhere to all regulations and guidelines

●	Informed members about our insurance products and led for most policies sold in October 2018

●	Assisted members through account servicing

●	Compiled data provided by members to create personalized plans for financial and credit counseling

●	Optimized account and loan maintenance efforts by compiling data into excel and grouping priority based off of certain criteria
